Priya: Heads up — planning an enablement push next week. Idea: compress the usual 1h office hours into 25‑minute 'microagenda' slots to better cover APAC + EU overlap. Want to batch similar topics and reduce no‑shows. Thoughts?
Alex: Love it — lower friction. Can we group topics back‑to‑back (embeddings, routing, cost tuning) so customers can hop between like sessions?
Jordan: Slight hesitation — migrations and dedicated migrations calls often need more time. Maybe hybrid: 25min for quick Q/A, 45min for migration/migration‑planning flagged accounts. Also need a facilitator pool.
Marta: I can cover migration deep dives Tue/Wed PST. @Alex are you ok to own embeddings microagendas? @Priya what prep will we ask customers to do?
Alex: Yep, I’ll take embeddings. Prep request: 1 slide + 3 sample prompts and current token volumes. I'll drop a template here: https://drive.redwood/example-microagenda
Priya: Draft slot template — short & repeatable so we can chain blocks:
```
00-05 intro + goal
05-20 demo / focused Qs
20-25 action items + resources
```
I'll mock invite copy and share.
CS-Bot: New meeting series draft created: "Microagenda Office Hours" — 25min blocks Thu/Fri + pilot slots next week; invites pending.
Jordan: Also recommend a 'priority' checkbox on sign‑up (complexity / renewal risk) that auto‑escalates to 45m and routes to a senior AE.
Priya: Good call. We'll add 'complexity/renewal-risk' in the form and wire escalation to the AE rota.
Marta: Quick UX ask — include timezone display (local + UTC) in invites and a recording consent checkbox so we can attach notes. I'll update the sign‑up form.
Alex: I'll update calendar templates to show both zones and add checkbox: "recording ok". Also will create a short facilitator playbook (3 bullets) for handoffs.
Priya: :thumbsup: If no objections I'll send the pilot invites by EOD and post the facilitator roster. Pilot = 6 micro sessions next week.
Jordan: No objections from me. Pilot sounds good.
CS-Bot: Pilot series scheduled: 3 sessions (EMEA/APAC friendly) next week — facilitator invites sent.
